catalog_quirks.body: Typhoon provides an ongoing, rate-limited research API, not monthly credits or a production SLA. Usage data is collected to improve the models and API; review the provider data-use terms before sending sensitive content. Chat, streaming, tool calling and both ASR endpoints were smoke-tested on October 7, 2026. The Isan model was tested with standard Thai speech, not an Isan accuracy benchmark. See https://docs.opentyphoon.ai/en/faq/ and https://docs.opentyphoon.ai/en/asr/.
